card.name: "and" after personnel or staff
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "personnel" or "staff" in warnings that trained people and treatments or equipment must be available for hypersensitivity reactions. Rarely on "Have" starting such a sentence.

modes.label: Personnel and therapies
modes.description: "and" joins trained personnel with therapies, medications or equipment that must be on hand.

modes.label: Staff and equipment
modes.description: "and" follows staff or personnel before resuscitation equipment or treatment.
modes.example: Always have trained staff<< and>> resuscitation equipment available.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward a thing or resource (therapies, medications, equipment) that goes with the personnel.
card.plain: It marks the "and" in "trained personnel and therapies available" warnings about handling allergic reactions.
